title: Subject Headings Identical to Descriptive Access Points
summary: Descriptive access points (main/added author, title, series entries) are not substitutes for subject headings. Assign subject headings for all topics and any required form headings even when they duplicate descriptive access points, because subject-limited searches retrieve only subject fields.
validation_rules: Assign subject headings for all topics of a work, and any required form headings, regardless of whether identical headings are already present as descriptive access points (1XX, 7XX, title, series). A subject heading duplicating a descriptive access point is not an error. (H 184 sec. 1)

A corporate body or person that is the author may also be assigned as a subject when the work is about it/them (e.g. `Insurance Corporation of Sri Lanka--Periodicals`, `Craig, Lulu Alice--Travel--Alaska`, `Communications Satellite Corporation--History`). (H 184 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. Assigning subject headings that duplicate descriptive access points
sections.text: Assign subject headings to bring out all topics of a work, as well as any form headings required for the work, without regard to whether identical headings have been assigned as descriptive access points.

sections.heading: 2. Examples illustrating duplication of descriptive access points by subject headings
sections.text:
```
110 2# $a Insurance Corporation of Sri Lanka.
245 00 $a Report & accounts - Insurance Corporation of Sri Lanka.
610 20 $a Insurance Corporation of Sri Lanka $v Periodicals.
650 #0 $a Insurance $z Sri Lanka $x Accounting $v Periodicals.

100 10 $a Craig, Lulu Alice.
245 10 $a Glimpses of sunshine and shade in the far North; $b or, My travels in the land of the midnight sun.
651 #0 $a Alaska $x Description and travel.
600 10 $a Craig, Lulu Alice $x Travel $z Alaska.

100 10 $a Yee, Rhoda.
245 10 $a Dim sum / $c by Rhoda Yee.
650 #0 $a Dim sum.

110 20 $a Communications Satellite Corporation.
245 10 $a Comsat at 10 : $b the first decade of the Communications Satellite Corporation.
610 20 $a Communications Satellite Corporation $x History.
650 #0 $a Artificial satellites in telecommunication $x History.
```
